title: Hum Azadare Hussain
body:
hum azadar e hussain ibne ali
hum tafardar e hussain ibne ali
hum wafadar e hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hum dua e fatema ka hai samar
aur aadaab e aza se ba khabar
jaante hai hum ko sab jinn o bashar
hai hamari sar-parast binte ali
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
saamne jis ke kata bhai ka sar
zibha pyase ho gaye noor e nazar
aur luta jangal mein jis ka ghar
bhai ke laash pe jo ro na saki
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum se poocho lazzat e saum o salaat
hum se poocho khadar e khhums o zakaat
hum se poocho kyun ruka hukme jihad
hum tawalla aur tabarra ke dhani
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye hamari khadr ye zeb o zain
ashk hamari marhame zakhme hussain
ye aza fatema ke dil ka chain
hum se raazi hai khuda uska nabi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
haasil e khilqat hamara hai aza
ye buka ye wa hussaina ki sada
hai hamari rooh ki girya ghiza
khoon baha to jism hote hai khavi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hum se pooch gham hai kya kya hai khushi
hai jo dil mein ulfate aale nabi
gham hai unka gham khushi unki khushi
bas yehi hai apna tarz e zindagi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dilon mein hamare karbobala
hum na is se aur na ye hum se juda
kaise hal min ki bhala bhoole sada
goonjti hai al-atash har ghadi
hum azadar e hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mehekte seenon pe zakhmon ke baagh
aur dil mein gham ke jalte hai charaagh
hum hai wo jin ko nahi gham se firaaq
bas faheem haan yehi hai bandagi
hum azadar e hussain...
author: Faheem
